sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emily. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat words and ideas. Today, we travel
to South America. We go to Argentina. Our city today is Salta. Salta is calm. Salta is
historic. Salta is close to nature. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's begin our journey.
Part two, Argentina and South America. Argentina is a large country. It is in South America.
Argentina has mountains. Argentina has plains. Argentina has cities and small towns. Many
people know Buenos Aires. Many people know Tango. But today, we visit Salta. Salta is different.
Salta is traditional and peaceful. Part three, where is Salta? Salta is in the north of
Argentina. It is close to the Andes Mountains. The city is not near the sea. It is high above sea
level. The air feels fresh. The sky looks wide and blue. Nature is very close to the city.
Mountains surround Salta. Part four, weather and seasons. Salta has four seasons. Summer is warm.
Sometimes it rains. Winter is dry and cool. Nights can be cold. Spring and autumn are
very nice. People enjoy walking outside. The weather is comfortable. Life feels balanced.
Part five, a city with long history. Salta has a long history. The city was founded many years ago.
Spanish culture is strong here. Indigenous culture is also strong. Old buildings are everywhere.
Churches and plazas tell stories. History is part of daily life.
The past is not far away. Part six, the main square. The heart of Salta is the main square.
It is called Plaza Nai de Julio. People meet here. People sit and talk. There are trees and benches.
There are cafes nearby. Life moves slowly in the square. The place feels friendly and open.
Part seven, colonial architecture. Salta is famous for its colonial buildings. The buildings are
old and beautiful. They have soft colors. They have balconies and arches. Walking in the city
feels calm. You feel like you are in the past. The city looks elegant and warm.
Part eight, culture and music. Culture is very important in Salta. People love music and dance.
Traditional music is popular. Guitars and folk songs are common. People sing together. They
celebrate traditions. Culture is a live in Salta. It is not only in museums. Part nine,
food in Salta. Food in Salta is simple and tasty. A popular food is empanadas. They are small
and filled with meat. People also eat corn and potatoes. Meals are warm and filling. People eat
together. Food brings people close. Part ten, daily for Salta. Daily life in Salta is slow.
People wake up early. They work in the morning. They rest in the afternoon. In the evening,
people go out. They meet friends and family. Life is calm. Life feels human and real.
Part eleven, nature around the city. Nature around Salta is beautiful.
There are mountains and valleys. People travel outside the city. They enjoy views and silence.
The landscape feels open and strong. Nature gives peace. Salta feels close to the earth.
Part twelve, feeling spirit and goodbye. Salta is a city of history, tradition,
mountains, music and slow life. It is not loud. It is not fast. It is calm. It is deep.
